_comment: Copy to .secret-scan.local.json, which is gitignored and must stay that way.
List the financial institutions your household actually uses. The commit
scanner will then reject staged changes that name them, because an institution
name identifies an account just as surely as its number does.
This file exists so those names never enter the repository. The scanner itself
carries no household-specific value; without a local config it falls back to
structural rules only (account-number shapes and credential literals), which
is why a fresh clone and CI are weaker here than your machine is.
Keep the list short. A long list produces false positives on ordinary prose
